## The question

Africa carries a large share of the world's health problems, but a small share of its research. When research on African problems is done, it is not always led by African researchers. This programme brings together studies that ask who produces research in Africa, who leads it, who funds it, and what is still missing.

## Studies in this programme

| Study | Status |
|---|---|
| [Ticks, climate and research equity](ticks-climate-equity.qmd), proposed by an African research team | In progress |
| Open access and research inequalities in Africa | Manuscript in preparation |
| [The determinants of COVID-19 case reporting across Africa](https://doi.org/10.3389/fpubh.2024.1406363) | Published · 2024 |
| [COVID-19 research in Africa: output, collaboration and leadership](https://www.mdpi.com/1660-4601/18/14/7273) | Published · 2021 |
